---
name: Song Request
about: Request additional MCSM tracks or variants.
title: "[SONG REQUEST]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Song Information

Provide the name of the song you would like to see added.

- **Song Title:**
- **Episode:**
- **Season:** (Season 1, Season 2, or Unknown)

---

## Scene or Context

Describe when or where the song plays in Minecraft: Story Mode.

For example:

- Main menu
- During a battle
- A specific cutscene
- A certain location
- Credits
- Other

---

## Replacement Suggestion (Optional)

If you have a preference, indicate which Minecraft music track this song should replace.

If you have no preference, write "No preference."

---

## Reference

If possible, provide a link to the song or a video containing it.

Examples:

- YouTube
- Soundtrack playlist
- Gameplay video
- Timestamp

---

## Additional Information

Provide any additional context that may help identify the requested song.

Examples include:

- Alternate names
- Approximate timestamp
- Instrumentation
- Whether it is ambient, battle music, menu music, etc.

---

## Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm the following:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this song has not already been requested.
- [ ] I have provided enough information to identify the requested song.
- [ ] I have included a reference link if one is available.
